purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0285 in the gauge arena: the species one orientation class carries, fail as derived (second run, after the first crashed in the reader before any gate): the Clifford hop of each class has 40 exact zeros on the side-4 box, 8 of them at the zone corners, and 72 on side 12 with Jacobian signs 36 + and 36 -, and the cycle levels of every class and half sit exactly on that set, so each orientation class carries 40 species on the box, not one of a hand: the staggered split leaves the doublers, and only a Wilson-shifted hop keeps one.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
